	- SimpleDAO.credit (../sb/simple_dao.sol#10)
	- SimpleDAO.donate(address) (../sb/simple_dao.sol#12-14)
	- SimpleDAO.queryCredit(address) (../sb/simple_dao.sol#24-26)
	- SimpleDAO.withdraw(uint256) (../sb/simple_dao.sol#16-22)
